10.-(1)  The  currency of  the Island  shall be  the  decimal 
currency provided  for in  this  Part  and  shall consist  of  the 
notes and coins in  such currency issued by  the Bank  under 
this  Act. 

(2) The  monetary  unit,  or  unit  of  currency, of  the 

Island  is  the  dollar. 

(3)  The  denominations  of  money  in  the  currency 

of  the  Island  are  the  dollar  and  the  cent. 

(4)  A  cent  is  one-hundredth  part  of  a dollar.
